For a standard, newly registered .com, with WHOIS privacy included, Cloudflare Registrar is the cheapest over 3 years.

Registrar	Year 1	Year 2	Year 3	WHOIS privacy	3-year total*
Cloudflare	~US$10	~US$10	~US$10	Free	~US$30
Namecheap	$11.28	$18.48	$18.48	Free for life	$48.24
GoDaddy India	₹1,049	₹1,499	₹1,499	Free	₹4,047

Cloudflare's model is different: it charges the registry/ICANN cost without a markup, including at renewal, and WHOIS redaction is included. 
Cloudflare
+2
Cloudflare Domains
+2

Namecheap currently lists .com at $11.28 for registration and $18.48/year for renewal, with privacy free for life. 
Namecheap
+1

GoDaddy India currently lists .com at ₹1,049 registration + ₹1,499 renewal, with free domain privacy. 
GoDaddy

🏆 My pick: Cloudflare

If you're only buying the domain, I'd go:

Cloudflare Registrar → .com → enable auto-renew

You save roughly $18+ over three years vs Namecheap, and substantially more vs GoDaddy.

One caveat: Cloudflare Registrar requires your domain to use Cloudflare nameservers, so if you specifically want to keep DNS elsewhere, Namecheap may be more convenient. 
Cloudflare Docs

If you give me the exact .com you're planning to buy, I can check its actual current price and availability and tell you which of the three is cheapest for that specific domain.

For Bengaluru → Chennai, three practical options currently available in India:

Provider	Current fare	Switching difficulty	Practical difference
redBus	From ₹313	Low	Biggest choice set: 338 daily buses across 79 operators; easy to compare and switch operators. 
redBus

FlixBus	From ₹359	Low–medium	29 daily trips, AC coaches, GPS tracking, digital tickets; moving from redBus mainly means using a separate booking account/app. 
FlixBus

KSRTC Karnataka	From ₹560	Medium	Government-operated option with ~20 Bengaluru–Chennai services; narrower choice but straightforward if you prefer KSRTC directly. 
redBus

Cost gap: FlixBus is about ₹46 more than the cheapest redBus-listed ticket, while KSRTC starts about ₹247 higher. Actual fares vary by date, seat and demand. 
redBus
+1

Switching effort: redBus → FlixBus is mostly just changing the booking interface; redBus → KSRTC also means accepting fewer departure/operator choices.
